I am renting this small plot, so I must be careful with my money. I grow beans together with maize and bananas like most of us here in Kagera, and I mostly rely on the cattle manure I can get from my neighbours since buying fertilizer from the shop is too expensive for me. I will keep my own seeds from last season because they grow well in our soil, and my husband and I will do most of the work ourselves. The rains here are usually enough, so I do not need to irrigate.
